avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer reduces pioglitazone levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; select alternative herbal supplement

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin/Rifabutin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP2C8/3A4 inducer significantly decreases pioglitazone concentrations
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid if possible; if necessary, monitor glucose closely and adjust dose

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate hypoglycemic effects when combined with pioglitazone
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose; inform patient of additive glucose-lowering effects

caution_supplements.name: Alpha-lipoic acid
caution_supplements.mechanism: May enhance insulin sensitivity and glucose lowering
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for hypoglycemia; coordinate dosing with healthcare provider

caution_supplements.name: Chromium
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose; assess need for pioglitazone dose adjustment

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay pioglitazone absorption and increase GI side effects
caution_foods.action: Take with or without food; consistent timing recommended

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (excessive)
caution_foods.mechanism: Increases hypoglycemia risk and may worsen fluid retention/heart failure complications
caution_foods.action: Limit alcohol intake; counsel on signs of hypoglycemia and heart failure exacerbation

monitoring_notes: Monitor for fluid retention, weight gain, and signs of heart failure exacerbation (especially in patients with pre-existing cardiac disease). Assess fasting glucose and HbA1c periodically; pioglitazone effect may take 4-8 weeks to manifest fully.
